text:
sam: Heads-up: proposing rename of metric_events.collected_at -> event_ts to standardize with Console and avoid confusing legacy ingestion hooks. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/analytics/pull/912

rita: Why rename instead of alias view? Risk: lots of dashboards and saved queries reference collected_at column explicitly.

sam: We evaluated view-only approaches. Problem: some downstream ETL jobs do INSERT ... SELECT * FROM metric_events and ORMs that use reflection will break. So approach = additive rename with compatibility view + dual-write.

noah: High-level migration plan:
1) add new nullable column event_ts to metric_events (no blocking lock)
2) change ingestion to dual-write both collected_at and event_ts for writes from next deploy
3) populate a compatibility view "metric_events_legacy" that exposes collected_at as COALESCE(collected_at, event_ts) for read-only consumers
4) run backfill for event_ts for last 180d in low-write tenants first
5) after validation, mark event_ts NOT NULL and switch console/default read paths to event_ts
6) deprecate collected_at column and drop after 120d of stable metrics

hannah: Billing gotcha: our billing pipelines join on timestamp bucket derived from collected_at. Need to keep bucket assignment identical. Proposal: add computed column bucket_ts = date_trunc('hour', COALESCE(event_ts, collected_at)) and keep it constant during transition so invoice math is stable.

rita: Backfill safety: skip tenants with >5k events/day, throttle to 200 inserts/sec, and use per-tenant pacing. We'll emit progress to /infra/backfills. Also add idempotency token to backfill jobs.

noah: Sample ALTERs I plan to run (concurrent where supported):
```sql
ALTER TABLE metric_events ADD COLUMN event_ts timestamptz;
-- switch writer in application config to populate event_ts
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW metric_events_legacy AS
SELECT id, route_id, metric_name, COALESCE(collected_at, event_ts) AS collected_at, payload
FROM metric_events;
```

sam: Console UX: add a "Schema migration" banner on tenant pages during rollout and a per-tenant toggle under Settings -> Data -> Schema compatibility (ON by default for managed tenants). Toggle should write an audit entry.

hannah: Monitoring: nightly diff job that runs a sample of 500 saved dashboards and compares counts/sums grouped by route+metric between legacy view and new event_ts path. Alert if count delta > 0.5% or p95 query latency regresses >20%. We'll also compare invoice totals in a dry-run mode.

rita: I'll prepare the safe-view SQL to ensure no cardinality changes. Also recommend adding a planner_hint for canary to prefer index on event_ts during perf tests.

noah: Backfill command (prototype):
```bash
python infra/backfill_eventts.py \
  --start 2025-12-01 \
  --end 2026-03-01 \
  --batch 5000 \
  --parallel-tenants 4 \
  --skip-hot-threshold 5000
```
This will write progress to S3 and emit metrics to prometheus under backfill.event_ts.progress.

sam: Rollout windows: staging -> canary 2% -> canary 25% -> global. Abort criteria: 
- nightly diff failures for 3 consecutive runs
- >1% cardinality mismatch for any critical dashboard
- billing invoice delta > $100 for affected accounts in dry-run

hannah: I'll own the billing smoke tests and invoice-delta alerting.

deploy-bot: PR #912 merged to staging. Migration-runner scheduled: 2026-03-22T02:00Z.

sam: Thanks everyone. Action items: rita to post compatibility view SQL and planner hints, noah to land backfill runner PR, hannah to wire billing checks, and I'll update Console toggle mock and run the first dry-run. We'll reconvene after first nightly diff. :+1:
